# Anurag Pardeshi

> Turning ideas into software solutions.

Anurag Pardeshi is a software engineer based in Indore, Madhya Pradesh, India. He builds scalable products with clean code and purposeful engineering.

## When to Use This Site

Use this site to learn about Anurag's projects, tech stack, and contact information.

## Recent Projects

- [Clozt](https://clozt.vercel.app/): Fashion storefront for collections, new arrivals, and everyday essentials
- [Wisdom World Academy](https://www.wisdomworldacademy.co.in/): School website with programmes, campus life, and visits in Indore
- [Bagiya](https://bagiya.vercel.app/): Mindful productivity app that turns focus sessions into a virtual garden
- [Built-fast (Agentic)](https://agentic-workflow.vercel.app/): AI website builder with editable source code exports
- [Stretus](https://stretus.com/): AI-assisted strategy infrastructure for financial platforms
- [TeethFast](https://lab.teethfast.in/): Digital dental lab platform for services, case files, and lab orders
- [Out](https://out-khaki-pi.vercel.app/): Cricket squad draft game with simulated matches and challenges with friends
